status: Round 10 candidate · stone finish and a connected mouth corner
detail: The pale pointed cheek defect was traced to the open front of the body mesh protruding under the skull. latestCaption: Round 9 · actual running-game capture from checkpoint bf4a523; visual and pacing gates remain open

reviews.gap: A fresh critic chose the official reference over the current character. The largest remaining gap is a pale pointed shape at the jaw’s rear cheek/neck attachment. The front cap and floating smile tube were improved, but this local junction still looks assembled.

reviews.verdict: Stone finish candidate · actual review pending
reviews.gap: A fresh critic selected the dominant pale courtyard and rim as the largest scene gap. The candidate adds coherent slab variation, restrained edge wear and properly mapped masonry sides within the same meshes, materials and textures. Actual before/after review is pending.

Checkpoint bf4a523 passes all 518 Node tests. The isolated browser run still fails full-HD pacing at 5.442 FPS with a 316.7 ms maximum gap. An independent reviewer found a GPU-completion assumption in the diagnostic that must be corrected; partial-scene measurements are not treated as a passing result.

rounds.title: Baseline · flat 2D broadcast
rounds.summary: Recorded the existing running game before the 3D transformation.

rounds.title: First construction · verdant ruins
rounds.summary: Original procedural serpent and rich environment, responsive broadcast shell, safe WebGL fallback and motion handling. Visual review is still open.

rounds.title: Round 2 · scene cleanup and performance
rounds.summary: Quiet weathered stone, deeper background, more visible fruit, correct occupancy and public-friendly intent. Capture exposed a shadow-map quality-switch bug; fixed and tested in the next round.

rounds.title: Round 3 · direct character comparison
rounds.summary: Shadow-map rendering is valid after resizing (GL error 0). Blind A/B reference won; character anatomy and close framing are being rebuilt. Portrait distance fog still needed correction.

rounds.title: Round 4 · continuous skull and portrait framing
rounds.summary: A frozen real public replay frame makes the character and camera evidence reproducible. The reference still wins facial expression. Static world merging improved measured throughput from 2.29 to 3.88 FPS without removing scenery; the performance gate remains open.

rounds.title: Round 5 · character expression and independent browser evidence
rounds.summary: The new face is rendered and the portrait controls no longer overlap. Independent CI passes 11 of 12 checks. Matched cache captures show the same real replay frame; speed at full HD is still below the required gate.

rounds.title: Round 6 · verified cache color and targeted visual corrections
rounds.summary: The display-color bake is pixel-identical to the preceding cache in the matched fixture, but full-HD speed remains 5.24 FPS. The next candidate keeps the large eyes while simplifying mouth layers, lowers the character camera, replaces plaid water and uses measured resolution adaptation. New actual captures and motion review are pending.

rounds.title: Round 7 · the character in its garden
rounds.summary: Actual captures show the lower camera, simplified facial outlines and organic water. A real 28.72-second motion recording exposes neutral, turning and eating states. Functional checks remain 11/12; pacing remains below 17 FPS and is being diagnosed further.

rounds.title: Round 8 · attached jaw and measured rendering diagnosis
rounds.summary: Actual images and gameplay motion were captured after the jaw and interface-compositing changes. The jaw still needs a rounded underside and an integrated mouth crease. Functional and regression checks pass; isolated pacing remains below the unchanged gate. The next experiment measures real renderer work and compares controlled rendering conditions.

rounds.title: Round 9 · shared mouth surface and independent measurement review
rounds.summary: Actual captures show the revised muzzle/jaw boundary. A fresh anonymous character comparison still favors the reference and pinpoints the rear mouth junction. Twelve of thirteen browser checks pass; pacing still fails. Independent technical review caught an invalid GPU-completion assumption, which is being corrected before interpreting totals.
